ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, when the slider on the air-cushion guide rail passes through the photoelectric gate, the light-blocking strip on it blocks the light, and the electronic timer can automatically record the light-blocking time $\Delta t$. The measured width of the light-blocking strip is $\Delta x$. Use $\frac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}$ to approximately represent the instantaneous velocity of the slider when it passes through the photoelectric gate. In order to make $\frac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}$ closer to the instantaneous velocity, the correct measure is ( )
A Replace it with a light-blocking strip of narrower width
B Improve the accuracy of measuring the width of the light-blocking strip
C Make the release point of the slider closer to the photoelectric gate
D Increase the angle between the air-cushion guide rail and the horizontal plane

method.method_draft: 从题干和图示确认：滑块上的遮光条通过光电门时，计时器记录遮光条完全经过光束所用的时间Δt，遮光条宽度为Δx，因此Δx/Δt表示滑块在遮光条宽度这段位移内的平均速度。要让这个平均速度更接近某一时刻的瞬时速度，就应缩短取平均的空间和时间范围，即减小Δx，使对应的Δt也变小。因此措施是换用宽度更窄的遮光条。
